items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Me and Bish got hung up in the door upside down.

ctx.x: The next accident was in '36. That was in the Cumberland Mountains. I don't know where we was going. We must have just left Baltimore, somewhere. Anyway, your road turned, and the bus driver didn't. He was after -- there was a loose bottle rolling up and down the aisle, and he turned around to tell somebody to pick up the bottle, and the road turned and he just kept going straight, and we went right down a 15-foot embankment. We landed at the bottom, end of the creek, and all

of that dust and running water, and reflection of the red lights from the bus on that dust, somebody hollared fire. And that did it. Me and Bish got hung up in the door upside down. The trumpet player, I don't know how the heck he got out, because you know, them buses had them windows that had the bars. I don't know how he got out, because when we got up to the top of the hill, up the road, he was standing up there waiting on us. I don't know how he got out of the bus. He got out that window some kind of way.
